**NorthernCrater {{VERSION}}** for Apple Silicon Macs.

Download `NorthernCrater-{{VERSION}}-arm64.dmg`, drag the app to Applications, and follow the README to open it the first time and to build the game engine from your own copy of FINAL FANTASY VII (Steam, the new release). This download contains **no game files** and no built engine.

macOS will warn when you first open it, because the app is not notarized by Apple. See "Opening it the first time" in the README.
